entities.name: Slavic Settlement & Samo's Empire
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Slavic tribes settled Bohemia and Moravia. Samo's tribal union (623–658) — the first recorded Slavic political entity — defeated the Frankish King Dagobert I at Wogastisburg (631/632).
